rca of the issue: CAUSE: Digital notes products in db.products carry category_id='b3d5584273c54195b8f9fa344111d789' which is a UUID stored as .hex (no dashes). The categories collection stores ids as str(uuid.uuid4()) (with dashes), so categories.find_one({id: <no-dash>}) finds nothing. EFFECT: list_products(kind='notes') filters query['category_id'] = {'$in': <uuid-with-dash list>}, matching 0 products. STEPS TO REPRODUCE: curl $URL/api/products?kind=notes -> []; curl $URL/api/products/bihar-daroga-complete-handwritten-notes-pdf -> category:null, category_id is 32-hex. MITIGATION: migrate db.products: for each notes product update category_id to the matching uuid.UUID(hex).__str__() form, or reseed the whole catalog with consistent id format. Simplest fix: in backend startup, run a migration that converts any 32-char hex category_id to the dashed form via str(uuid.UUID(hex)).
